pages.text: Open Grimoire → Schematics. Circles I–VII require every page through 2/3/5/7/9/10/12. The bottom button cycles pages and the combined overlay. Each page needs a closed contour around Creation. Scroll to zoom. Align on the overlay table sorts and centers pages.
Circle 1: Wind stream. Creation. Requires all pages 1–2.
Circle 1: Gust. Creation + Movement. Requires all pages 1–2.
Circle 1: Air cushion. Creation + Density. Requires all pages 1–2.
Circle 2: Air strike. Creation + Movement + Density. Requires all pages 1–3.
Circle 2: Wind screen. Creation. Requires all pages 1–3.
Circle 2: Wind jump. Creation + Movement. Requires all pages 1–3.
Circle 3: Wind blade. Creation + Movement + Density. Requires all pages 1–5.
Circle 3: Whirlwind. Creation + Movement + Area. Requires all pages 1–5.
Circle 3: Air shackles. Creation + Density + Link. Requires all pages 1–5.
Circle 4: Air dome. Creation + Area + Defense. Requires all pages 1–7.
Circle 4: Blade barrage. Creation + Movement + Density + Quantity. Requires all pages 1–7.
Circle 4: Air step. Creation + Density + Space. Requires all pages 1–7.
Circle 5: Hurricane. Creation + Movement + Area + Link. Requires all pages 1–9.
Circle 5: Thunderclap. Creation + Density + Area. Requires all pages 1–9.
Circle 5: Silence zone. Creation + Area + Defense + Link. Requires all pages 1–9.
Circle 6: Pressure prison. Creation + Density + Link + Space. Requires all pages 1–10.
Circle 6: Sky corridor. Creation + Movement + Space. Requires all pages 1–10.
Circle 6: Blade storm. Creation + Movement + Density + Area + Quantity. Requires all pages 1–10.
Circle 7: Sky rupture. Creation + Movement + Density + Area. Requires all pages 1–12.
Circle 7: Great cyclone. Creation + Movement + Area + Link + Space. Requires all pages 1–12.
Circle 7: Sky bastion. Creation + Density + Defense + Space. Requires all pages 1–12.

References do not grant pages or unlock circles. Creation belongs in the center of every page. Specific casting effects currently exist for 21 Fire forms of circles 1–6. Other forms and circle 7 are still planned.
